subject: [PATCH v4 1/3] mm: swap: move LRU insertion out of the swap cache allocator

reviews.author: Alexandre Ghiti
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Alexandre Ghiti noted that the patch does not address the issue of swap cache folios being added to the LRU before they are fully initialized, which can lead to incorrect behavior in certain scenarios.

Reviewer Alexandre Ghiti thanked the patch submitter without raising any specific technical concerns or objections.

2026-09-15.patch_summary: This patch moves the insertion of a new folio into the LRU (Least Recently Used) list out of the swap cache allocator function. The current implementation adds the folio to the LRU immediately, which prevents callers from acting on the folio before it becomes visible for reclaim. This change is necessary for two use cases: refault evaluation and zswap writeback dropbehind. By deferring the LRU insertion to the callers of __swap_cache_alloc_folio(), there is no functional change intended, but rather a preparatory step for future changes.
